description: This file contains unit tests for the ClientRepository class within the OAuth component of the OrangeHRM system. It tests retrieving client entities and validating clients with various scenarios, including active, disabled, and non-existent clients.

classes.name: ClientRepositoryTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the ClientRepository's functionality in retrieving and validating OAuth clients.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by loading test fixture data from a YAML file into the database.

methods.name: testGetClientEntity
methods.description: Tests retrieval of client entities by ID, verifying properties like identifier, name, redirect URI, confidentiality, and display name, including cases for non-existent or disabled clients.

methods.name: testValidateClient
methods.description: Tests the validation of clients with various parameters, including existence, secrets, confidentiality, and client status.
